subject: FleetPay MAP — Evidence plan, retention windows & SIG clarifications
messages:
From: Anna Keller <anna.keller@fleetpay.com>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@fleetpay.com
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: FleetPay MAP: initial SIG questions and retention baselines

Hi Laura / Marcus,

Thanks again for the demo last week — FleetPay's security team reviewed the slides and we have a short list of clarifying questions to fold into the MAP. The attached spreadsheet has our SIG/CAIQ rows with a few cells marked: two items relate to evidence artifacts, one to DPA clause mapping, and one to log retention default.

Top asks from Security (summarized):
- SIG: can you confirm which controls are covered by the hosted runtime versus customer-managed network?
- Evidence: example artifacts for encryption-at-rest key rotation and SOC 2 change logs — do you have expected filenames/formats?
- DPA: we need the canonical data deletion flow and the retention window post-contract termination. Example: 90 vs 180 days vs 1 year.

We're trying to map these items into the MAP milestones so procurement and security can align on close dates. Can you point us to a single evidence index (CSV or Drive) and confirm a proposed retention default?

Attachments: fleetpay-sig-questions.xlsx

Cheers,
Anna
Anna Keller
Head of IT Risk, FleetPay

From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@fleetpay.com>
Cc: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 11:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FleetPay MAP: initial SIG questions and retention baselines

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear spreadsheet. We reviewed and drafted an initial evidence index attached. High level replies below and a suggestion for how to fold items into the MAP milestones.

Quick answers:
- Runtime vs network: Redwood Hosted (standard MAP) covers application-layer controls, container hardening, and key management in the hosting environment. Customer-managed network (Private) shifts network perimeter controls to you — we'll mark those SIG rows as "conditional (Private)" in the CSV.
- Example artifacts: we typically provide:
  * kms-rotation-report-YYYYMMDD.zip (key rotation audit export)
  * soc2-change-log-YYYYMM.csv (change management evidence)
  * access-review-<team>-YYYYQ#.pdf (quarterly access attestation)
These are in the attached evidence-index.csv template.
- DPA / retention: our default hosted retention for customer data after contract termination is 90 days; backups are retained 180 days for SLA restoration. For regulated customers we support 30/90/180 windows by request; we can add this as a MAP option and tie acceptance to the SIG/DPA milestone.

Proposed MAP updates (to slot into your timeline):
- Security review complete (SIG/CAIQ answers delivered) 
  -> deliverable: redwood_SIG_response_v1.pdf + evidence-index.csv (due within 5 business days)
- Evidence handoff (sample artifacts shared)
  -> deliverable: kms-rotation-report + access-review sample + one SOC2 artifact (due within 10 business days)
- DPA sign and retention selection (Procurement + Legal)
  -> deliverable: signed DPA and chosen retention window (target 30 days after evidence handoff)

I've attached redwood_SIG_response_v1.pdf and the evidence-index.csv populated with suggested filenames. Marcus, can you confirm we can produce the rotation and access artifacts within 7 business days of Anna's sign-off?

— Laura
Laura Bennett
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference

From: marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Anna Keller <anna.keller@fleetpay.com>
Cc: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FleetPay MAP: initial SIG questions and retention baselines

On Wed, Nov 18, 2026 at 11:03 AM laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai> wrote:
> I've attached redwood_SIG_response_v1.pdf and the evidence-index.csv populated with suggested filenames. Marcus, can you confirm we can produce the rotation and access artifacts within 7 business days of Anna's sign-off?

Anna — I'll own the artifact pulls. Quick operational notes from my side so the MAP has realistic acceptance criteria: 
- Key rotation export: we can generate kms-rotation-report-YYYYMMDD.zip; it contains key IDs, rotation timestamp, and KMS policy versions. We will redact principal IDs in the example artifact but provide full data under NDA if needed.
- SOC2 change logs: we can produce soc2-change-log-YYYYMM.csv; it is a rolling monthly export. For the MAP we suggest providing the latest 3 months as sample evidence (not full commit history).
- Log retention: Redwood application logs (request traces, error traces) are kept 90 days by default; platform system logs are 365 days. If FleetPay requests a different window we can add a MAP task to confirm and update DPA appendix.

Soojin — looping you for a quick security sign-off on the proposed default retention mappings and the redaction approach.

Thanks,
Marcus
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: soojin_lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
To: Anna Keller <anna.keller@fleetpay.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, marcus_lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: FleetPay MAP: initial SIG questions and retention baselines

Hi Anna — quick clarifications from SecOps that we'd like reflected in the MAP acceptance criteria before we move to DPA/Procurement: 
- Evidence format: sample artifacts should be time-stamped and include a human-readable summary in the header (we will provide the header template).
- Redaction: production PII must be redacted from shared artifacts; however, unredacted artifacts can be made available under an encrypted transfer and NDA clause for final validation.
- Retention mapping: accept the proposed defaults (app logs 90d, platform sys logs 365d, backups 180d) but recommend FleetPay choose a retention profile in the MAP (Profile A = default; Profile B = regulated (365 app logs); Profile C = custom).
- SIG row: we'll mark network-perimeter controls as "conditional" for Private deployments in the CSV; please confirm whether FleetPay plans a Private or Hosted deployment in the next call.

If these points look good I'll add a short acceptance checklist and send to Procurement for DPA signoff. Anna — would you and your procurement lead be available for a 30-minute call Monday to lock the retention profile? If so, Marcus and I will bring the artifacts and a short runbook for evidence delivery.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Security Operations, Redwood Inference
